svg.title: W4 Workload Execution Flow
svg.desc: Flow chart showing current W4 workload execution logic.
svg.text: The flow starts from multi-node harness launch, dispatches 15 service descriptors, crosses ChipBackend/simpler-capi into simpler, then returns through ChipBackend, sim-uapi handled result, and QEMU flush_cq.
Pass condition: sim-uapi ingress routes QEMU descriptors; ChipBackend calls simpler-capi/simpler; sim-uapi egress feeds QEMU flush_cq -> guest CQ.
